name: Ring modulation: envelope on mix for bells, on tune for stabs, LFO for pulsing pads
goal: Use ring modulation (audio-rate amplitude modulation of a carrier by a modulator, heard as tremolo taken to the extreme) to get metallic and bell tones: a pluck-shaped envelope on ring-mod mix for bells, the same envelope on ring-mod detune for synthetic stabs, or a slow LFO on mix/detune for subtle pulsing pads, placed at the 'consider FM/ring mod' point of the patch workflow.

source.title: What is Ring Modulation? | Intro to Synths Part 12

prerequisites: Synth with a ring modulator (insert or dedicated osc) exposing mix and detune/ratio, an envelope and an LFO assignable to them

inputs.name: patch_type
inputs.description: lead | pluck | pad | bass — decide first

outputs.name: ringmod_patch
outputs.description: Bell, stab or pulsing pad variant

steps.action: Decide the patch type (lead, pluck, pad, bass), pick an initial oscillator and set the amp envelope and mono/poly mode around it.
Shape the raw sound first (osc configuration, sync, unison), tweak amp envelope, then filters; this is where ring mod or FM is considered.
steps.expect: Ring mod added onto a working voice

steps.action: Add a ring modulator (carrier × modulator, carrier mix only). Learn the two controls: mix = effect strength; detune = splits the tone into two distinct pitches. Unlike FM, the lower pitch also shifts slightly as you detune, at a different rate from the upper pitch.
steps.expect: Metallic, more aggressive than FM, with bell-like partials

steps.action: Bells: assign a pluck-shaped envelope (fast attack, short decay, low sustain) to ring-mod mix.
steps.expect: Bright metallic strike that decays into the clean tone

steps.action: Stabs: assign the same pluck envelope to ring-mod detune/tuning instead.
Pads: assign a slow LFO to ring-mod mix or detune at low depth.
steps.expect: Subtle pulsing shimmer inside a sustained pad

steps.action: Then add LFOs/envelopes on other params, portamento/legato and trigger/phase-reset choices to finish character; iterate back and forth.

verification: Mix at 0 gives the clean carrier; raising it adds metallic partials
Envelope on mix yields a bell attack; on detune yields a stab
LFO depth on a pad is subtle (pulse, not tremolo chop)
constraints: Ground every step in the source YouTube-provided Show-transcript text; do not invent UI paths or numeric settings not stated there. Numbers quoted are the presenter's approximate values, in the source synth's own units.

Original synthesis / signal-flow only — map brand UI (Vital/Ableton/Dune/Massive X/etc.) to portable osc/filter/env/LFO/FX modules for a Traveler-inspired or Web Audio hybrid; never rip presets, wavetables, or samples.
Not affiliated with plugin/synth vendors named in the source video.
Distinct from audio-rate-am-wave-shape-texture (self-AM wave-shaping via VCA) and fm-carrier-modulator-ratio-basics: this covers ring-mod mix/detune envelope recipes.
Web Audio: multiply carrier by modulator with a GainNode whose gain AudioParam is driven by an OscillatorNode; crossfade dry/ring via gain for 'mix'.
